title: Dharma Durai
desc: Dharmadurai, a heartbroken doctor, turns to alcohol and becomes the source of embarrassment for his family. However, a meeting with an old friend changes his life for good.

title: Andhaghaaram
desc: The lives of a blind librarian, dispirited cricketer and desolate psychiatrist seek retribution as their lives coincide under unsettling circumstances.

title: Operation Raavan
desc: As a serial killer targets brides, a magnate's son goes undercover at a news station, sparking a lethal game of cat and mouse.

title: Revolver Rita
desc: A woman begins to chase down the culprits after her handbag is stolen. However, things take a turn when the thieves find weapons in their loot, causing them to question the identity of their victim.

title: Ee Pattanathil Bhootham
desc: An evil magician releases a friendly spirit and orders him to make money through crime. However, the spirit falls into the hands of circus children after the sorcerer loses him in an accident.
